semanticReconciliation: The original planning-only hold is superseded by SRC-INT-001; authority boundaries themselves remain required.
The baseline mutation decision resolves to create_task only; manual preparation uses the same stored-proposal approval endpoint.
P0-R01-C04 is exercised as a cold-process bootstrap simulation. It is not represented as a complete new-agent autonomous handoff experiment.
Every baseline check mapped to C-05-4 retains a deferred live-provider portion. No mock result closes that portion.
Baseline full manual CRM parity was never required; Explore inspection and manual task preparation are the supported fallback.
Baseline waived/rejected/deferred exclusions remain visible and do not become an executable Phase 5 backlog.
Existing P1-P4 checkpoints remain in events.jsonl; this is the final review/reconciliation phase, not a rewrite of completed development.
